job.command: echo KVM:; ls -la /dev/kvm 2>&1; id; echo CPU:; nproc; grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo; echo MEM:; free -g | head -2; echo DISK:; df -h / | tail -1; echo JAVA:; java -version 2>&1 | head -2; echo ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT; ls $ANDROID_HOME 2>/dev/null; echo --- emulator:; ls $ANDROID_HOME/emulator 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo --- system-images:; find $ANDROID_HOME/system-images -maxdepth 3 2>/dev/null; echo --- platforms:; ls $ANDROID_HOME/platforms 2>/dev/null; echo --- cmdline:; ls $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools 2>/dev/null; which sdkmanager avdmanager adb emulator 2>/dev/null; echo CACHE:; ls ~/.cache/cloudpc-models 2>/dev/null | head
